rules.statement: A party seeking to cancel a decree entered by mistake must apply to the Supreme Court for an order directing the lower court to investigate and report on the allegation of mistake, rather than bringing a separate action.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think, therefore, that this Court has jurisdiction on application by petition duly supported by affidavit to grant an order upon the Judge of first instance in certain cases of alleged error upon judgment, to inquire into and to ascertain, and then to correct if necessary and right so to do, by restitutio in integrum."
